# Third-party sources

This directory isolates upstream source snapshots from the participant runtime.
Each project retains its original license, README, and internal structure.

- [`amazon-reviews-2023/`](amazon-reviews-2023/) contains the upstream Amazon
  Reviews 2023 research repository used for dataset provenance. The application
  does not import or execute it during evaluation.

Dataset attribution and redistribution notes are documented in
[`../DATA_ATTRIBUTION.md`](../DATA_ATTRIBUTION.md).
